svg.text: in run A's launch and work directories
no head.pid written: the head stops
a umask 002 no longer refuses Resume
a rebuilt run has no launch command:
head.pid not written, no engine, so
a missing one proves never started
on disk, under the runs root: a Resume of a Resume

svg.text: 5 · a lineage runs in its first run's directories
B and C run their engines in A's directories, lineage_id A
each run keeps its own .spectio/, head files and state
read from the first run's directories
dir_run_id: lineage_id, else the run's own ID
a job's files, the failures' log tails
a child looked in its own empty dirs:
no job files, no failure tails
one .snakemake/log/ for the lineage, from the test
